title: AssetManifestEntry
description: One entry of asset_manifest.json. See references/07-asset-pipeline.md.

source.description: Selection-order priority: user > source_document > generated_vector > generated_still > external_licensed > synthetic_filler (references/07-asset-pipeline.md).

provenance.description: Required when source is generated_vector or generated_still.

background_treatment.description: Set for image/video assets with a plain, busy, or otherwise unappealing/inconsistent background. See references/07-asset-pipeline.md (Background cleanup). An asset flagged 'needs_cleanup' must not be composited until it becomes 'removed_chromakey' or 'removed_ai_matte' (or 'not_applicable' if reviewed and judged fine as-is).

method.description: e.g. ffmpeg colorkey, ffmpeg chromakey, rembg, remove.bg API, Photoroom API.
